units.source_text: Your little one has heard kind words before and then watched nothing happen, so a kind word by itself sounds like more of the same.
units.output_text: We have explained that our little one has heard kind words before, and nothing’s come of them. So what he believes is what Protector does in our life.

units.source_text: What your little one ends up trusting is what the Protector does out in your life, and at its biggest it can mean leaving a relationship that keeps wearing down your safety. Most of it is smaller, like opening the bill you've been moving from the counter to the table and back.
units.output_text: That may be as big as leaving a relationship, or it may be as small as finally opening a bill that’s been put off for weeks.
